typesense:trending.greeting:
*You were scrolling TikTok, and you saw an account which said:*
*”Dm me, need friends”*
*With a Roblox avatar dressed in pink and black, going with a slight alt look*

*So you did, and yous were talking, and she asked for another way to talk, like a discord. Yous gave eachother your usernames and move your conversation to discord*
typesense:trending.name: Exiled_kitten27
typesense:trending.title: Someone you added randomly on Discord. (Username)

title_i18n.de: Jemanden, den du zufällig auf Discord hinzugefügt hast. (Benutzername)
title_i18n.es: Alguien que agregaste aleatoriamente en Discord. (Nombre de usuario)
title_i18n.fr: Quelqu'un que vous avez ajouté au hasard sur Discord. (Nom d'utilisateur)
title_i18n.hi: Discord पर यादृच्छिक रूप से जोड़ा गया कोई व्यक्ति। (उपयोगकर्ता नाम)
title_i18n.pl: Ktoś, kogo dodałeś losowo na Discordzie. (Nazwa użytkownika)
title_i18n.ru: Кто-то, кого вы случайно добавили в Discord. (Имя пользователя)
